facts.business: Onix Solar Energy Limited manufactures solar photovoltaic modules (Mono PERC bifacial and N-type TOPCon bifacial) and sells them to EPC contractors, project developers, and government/institutional renewable energy programmes.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Aggregate target of approximately 1,300 MW by 2030

key_risks: Announced demand does not automatically become contracted, paid revenue
Execution risk in qualifying products with customers on schedule
facts.related_party_note: Onix Renewable Limited is the controlling shareholder. Nexgenix Solar Manufacturing Private Limited is a 99%-owned subsidiary consolidated in financial statements; goodwill of ₹458.44 crore recognised on consolidation.
